IC1: Of either gender, aged ≥19 and ≤70 years
IC2: Atopic dermatitis [AND] subjects who are coincident with Hanifin and Rajka diagnosis criteria
IC3: Subacute [OR] and chronic atopic subjects who have atopic dermatitis symptoms continually at least 6 months
IC4: Subjects with over moderate atopic dermatitis [AND] (SCORAD score > 20)
IC5: Subjects who understand and voluntarily sign an informed consent form
